description.value: The study examined whether post-traumatic stress symptoms and trauma load were associated with regional gray matter volume in combat-exposed veterans, and compared gray matter volume between veterans with and without PTSD.

spans.text: We examined the relationship between PTSS and gray matter among combat-exposed U.S. military veterans.

design.value: Cross-sectional voxel-based morphometry study of structural MRI data from 28 combat-exposed OEF/OIF veterans, using dimensional regression analyses of CAPS scores and trauma load followed by a PTSD versus non-PTSD group contrast.

spans.text: Structural brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was obtained on 28 combat veterans from Operations Enduring and Iraqi Freedom.
Images were analyzed using voxel-based morphometry, and regressed against the total CAPS score and trauma load.
Images were subsequently analyzed by diagnosis of PTSD vs. non-PTSD.
Past month PTSS were assessed using the Clinician-Administered PTSD Scale (CAPS) (Blake et al., 1995).
